    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Every node is a button labelled with its name, kind, status, what it does and its calls in the last minute; aria-expanded tells whether its card is open
      - listitem: The card is a dialog; its close button takes focus, Esc closes it
      - listitem: "A visually hidden list gives the same picture as text: every node, its status, whom it called how often in the last minute and its cost"
      - listitem: "\"needs you\" and \"failed\" chips sit in a polite live region, so a waiting or failed agent is announced"
      - listitem: "Status is never color alone: waiting and failed agents get a badge (clock, exclamation mark) and a text line under the name"
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: On the first draw the lead pops in, then the agents, then the tools around the orbit – each link draws itself towards the node it reaches
      - listitem: Every call sends a short line along its link that fades out behind, with a light glow – blue for a call, green for the answer, amber for you, red for an error; the node it lands on ripples once
      - listitem: Links are one even 1.5px line each in a light gray, with one rounded right-angled turn, busy or not – only the moving lines carry color
      - listitem: Working agents breathe with a soft ring, waiting ones a little quicker in amber
      - listitem: When nodes come or go every node glides to its new place on a spring – a new tool slides out of the first agent it is linked to; a leaving one shrinks away while its link pulls back
      - listitem: One requestAnimationFrame loop drives gliding and pulses; it pauses when the graph is off screen or the tab is hidden
      - listitem: "With prefers-reduced-motion nothing glides or travels: a link simply lights up for each call"
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The width is measured with a ResizeObserver and the whole layout is computed from it – orbits, node sizes and label room
      - listitem: Below 520px the graph turns taller than wide, nodes get smaller, labels use their short names, the model line is left out and the card docks to the bottom of the graph
      - listitem: Labels and the outer orbit always stay inside the panel – nothing is cut off and nothing scrolls sideways, down to 320px
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Performance" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Links that share a side of a node run side by side, 8px apart (6px on narrow graphs) and centred on it, ordered so they never cross; a link that would run through a node turns the other way round
      - listitem: Positions, link paths and pulses are written straight to the DOM in the frame loop – React only re-renders when your data changes
      - listitem: Pass only recent calls (the last minute or two); older ones count for nothing but are still compared on each render
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Pass the whole nodes and calls arrays every time something changes; a call's id must stay the same while its status goes from pending to ok/error
      - listitem: Calls older than four seconds when they first appear don't send a pulse – they only count towards heat and calls per minute
      - listitem: Brand logos are not part of the component – pass them as icon; the UI icons are Hugeicons Free (MIT), keep the credit comment
      - listitem: The link color is --ui-aggc-link (a light gray); calls use --ui-aggc-pulse, answers --ui-aggc-ok
      - listitem: Keep it to a handful of agents and about a dozen outer nodes – more get crowded on the outer orbit
